items.title: Stocks lost $2 trillion. The market is wrong about AI
items.summary: The stock market lost $2 trillion in 40 minutes, and AI stocks took the worst of it, with Intel down more than half since October and AMD off 17% in a day. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down why it happened and why he thinks the market is wrong, from GPU rental prices up 106% to the CPU boom and Anthropic's IPO valuation.

items.title: $3 trillion wipe-out, CEOs on the volatility of politics, and the status of the AI trade
items.summary:
Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi gives his thoughts on the recent tech sell-off and what a bear market means for the AI trade. Plus, what the Qualcomm (QCOM) CEO and other business leaders are saying about the volatile state of politics. 

Sozzi sits down for a 1-on-1 with Affirm (AFRM) CEO Max Levchin to discuss the company's earnings and the midterm results.

items.title: A $25 Billion Fund Just Bought These 3 Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA $25 billion fund made Nokia (NOK), Qualcomm (QCOM:NASDAQ), and Alphabet (GOOGL:NASDAQ) its three biggest new or added positions in Q3. All three stocks have fallen since Sept.
